description: Make 1D barcodes as SVG or PNG: Code 128 (any printable ASCII; digit runs packed with subset C automatically), EAN-13 (12 digits, check digit added; or 13, check digit verified), UPC-A (11 or 12 digits, same) and Code 39 (A-Z, 0-9, space, - . $ / + %, optional mod-43 check). Same encoders, quiet zones, guard bars and human-readable digits as the website. Give "value" for one barcode, or "values" (up to 1000) to write one file per value into a folder; invalid values are reported, not fatal. PNG text uses the system monospace font. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/barcode-gen/

code39Check.description: Code 39 only: append the mod-43 check character.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

showText.description: Print the human-readable text/digits under the bars.

values.description: Or: many values; each becomes its own file in the output folder.

name: barcode_generate
title: Barcode generator
